faqContactInfoQ: How do I update my internal profile details?
faqContactInfoA: Open the Profile tab, update your contact details or profile photo, then choose Save Changes. If you change your email address, complete the verification step before it becomes active.
faqCaseStatusQ: Why do I only see certain cases, legal reviews, or volunteer records?
faqCaseStatusA: Internal access is based on your assigned role, committee, and case workload. Admins have the widest access, while staff, case officers, and legal personnel see the operational areas assigned to them.
faqTwoFactorQ: Where do I find my assigned work queues?
faqTwoFactorA: Use the sidebar to open the queue for your role: Cases and Case Interviews for case officers, Legal Reviews for legal personnel, Volunteer Applications for membership committee staff, and Projects or Tasks for staff/admin users.
faqProfileVisibilityQ: Who can see the information in my internal profile?
faqProfileVisibilityA: Your internal profile is visible to authorized SAVIRA personnel who manage accounts, assignments, and operational workflows. It is not shown to complainants or public users.
faqDeactivateQ: What should I do if my access, assignments, or account status look wrong?
faqDeactivateA: Use Contact Support from this page and include the route, record ID, and a short description of the issue. For urgent access problems, contact an administrator so your role, committee, or assignment can be reviewed.

aboutBody: Scouts Against Sexual Harassment and Abuse (SASHA) is a Scout-led organization established in 2022 to address issues of sexual harassment and abuse affecting children, women, youth, and LGBTQIA+ individuals. It unites members from different sectors who share a commitment to gender equality and social justice.
aboutMissionBody: To defend and uphold the rights of vulnerable sectors against sexual harassment and abuse by providing structured reporting mechanisms, responsible case management, and sustained advocacy.
aboutVisionBody: A society where safe spaces are ensured, abuse is not tolerated, and survivors are supported with dignity, respect, and justice.
aboutValueSafeBody: SASHA maintains a firm stance against all forms of sexual harassment and abuse. We advocate for prevention, survivor protection, and accountability to ensure safe and respectful spaces for everyone.
aboutValueEqualityBody: SASHA upholds the equal rights, dignity, and opportunities of all genders. The organization actively challenges discrimination, harmful stereotypes, and systems that enable inequality and abuse.
aboutValueYouthBody: SASHA believes that young people are not only beneficiaries of protection but also leaders of change. The organization promotes youth participation in advocacy, education, and decision-making processes.
